# CloneGuard

> CloneGuard is a brand protection company built specifically for iGaming and Crypto businesses. It provides continuous impersonation monitoring, takedowns, trademark registration, and legal brand enforcement (cease and desist, opposition filings, domain disputes), delivered under a single point of contact rather than as separate vendors. Services are available as annual subscription plans (Foundation, Growth, Enterprise) or quoted individually for businesses that need one-off work.

CloneGuard exists because generalist brand protection vendors are slow and cautious about serving iGaming and Crypto, industries with heavy regulatory scrutiny and fast-moving impersonation tactics (cloned casino sites, fake sportsbook ads, fake app store listings, lookalike exchange domains, fake wallet extensions, deepfake support impersonation). CloneGuard works exclusively in these two verticals.

## Services

- [Protection Plans](https://cloneguard.co/protection-plans.html): The three subscription tiers (Foundation, Growth, Enterprise), what's included in each, and how they compare.
- [Monitoring & Takedowns](https://cloneguard.co/monitoring-takedowns.html): Continuous detection of impersonating sites, ads, apps, and social accounts, with verified takedown requests.
- [Trademark Registration](https://cloneguard.co/trademarks.html): UK, EU, and global trademark filing to give brand enforcement legal standing.
- [Brand Enforcement](https://cloneguard.co/brand-enforcement.html): Escalation when a takedown request isn't enough, cease and desist letters, negotiations, opposition filings, letters of protest, cancellations, and domain disputes.
- [Specialist Services](https://cloneguard.co/specialist-services.html): Executive and VIP protection, cyber insurance placement, and domain and IP portfolio strategy, available on request.

## Industries

- [iGaming Protection](https://cloneguard.co/igaming.html): How CloneGuard protects online casinos and sportsbooks from clone sites, brand-hijacking ad campaigns, and fake app listings.
- [Crypto Protection](https://cloneguard.co/crypto.html): How CloneGuard protects exchanges and crypto platforms from lookalike domains, fake wallet extensions, and deepfake support impersonation.
